mapper.select: SELECT pkid AS pkid, view_id AS viewId, tpl_id AS tplId, shadow_cfg_id AS shadowCfgId, old_cfg_id AS oldCfgId, new_cfg_id AS newCfgId, status AS status, created_by AS createdBy, DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime, updated_by AS updatedBy, DATE_FORMAT(updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedTime FROM ssm_query_template_cfg_promote_log WHERE view_id = #{viewId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ssm_query_template_cfg_promote_log ( view_id, tpl_id, shadow_cfg_id, old_cfg_id, new_cfg_id, status, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{viewId}, #{tplId}, #{shadowCfgId}, #{oldCfgId}, #{newCfgId}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ssm_query_template_cfg_promote_log SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE view_id = #{viewId}
